    Profile

    Plumeria is a Wratharis Knight who mastered the magic of the Court Mage. A young lady from a noble family, she is a bit naïve and distant from the ways of the world. She always remembers receiving high marks and compliments since she was young, and loves to return the favor by giving A+'s to others as well.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 156cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Mar 4
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Flowers, lively places
    Hobbies: Horseriding, reading
    Illust: トマル
    CV: 八木侑紀
